description: Defines the QpackInstructionDecoder class for decoding QPACK instructions in QUIC, including error handling, state management, and interface for decoding instruction fields.

classes.name: QpackInstructionDecoder
classes.description: Decodes QPACK instructions, manages decoding state, and communicates decoded instructions or errors via a delegate.

classes.name: QpackInstructionDecoder::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for receiving decoded instructions and error notifications during decoding.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Provides a data fragment to decode; returns success or failure.

methods.name: AtInstructionBoundary
methods.description: Checks if decoding is at an instruction boundary.

methods.name: varint2
methods.description: Returns the second decoded varint value.
